description: This pie chart illustrates the "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," displaying a total of three distinct categories. The largest segment, colored dark green and labeled "LOCAL," accounts for 94.5% of the distribution. The remaining two smaller segments are visually emphasized by being slightly exploded or offset from the main body of the pie. These consist of a dark red slice labeled "LLM" representing 3.9%, and a dark blue slice labeled "EDGE_P2P" representing 1.6%. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, category labels are positioned just outside their respective slices, while the exact percentage values are displayed directly inside each segment. Visually, the segments are arranged in descending order of size.
